The United Nations was established, its purpose was to resolve disputes peacefully through But the veto power of the Security Council has often become an obstacle during the Cold War. The world was divided into two opposite camps. The threat of nuclear weapons served as an overwhelming deterrent, but the world was Constantly on the edge of crisis Even after the Cold War ended New threats such as regional conflicts, terrorism, and cyberattacks have continued to emerge No problem can be resolved by one nation alone The work of a diplomat is to build bridges between opposing interests for nations that oppose one another to find mutual benefit. That is the ultimate objective of diplomacy.
